subject: Social Studies
text: Who was the first President of India?
explanation: Dr. Rajendra Prasad was the first President of India, serving from 1950 to 1962.

subject: Social Studies
text: The French Revolution began in which year?
explanation: The French Revolution began in 1789 with the storming of the Bastille.

subject: Social Studies
text: Which latitude passes almost halfway through India?
explanation: The Tropic of Cancer (23°30'N) passes almost halfway through India.

subject: Social Studies
text: Who was the author of the book 'The Social Contract'?
explanation: Jean-Jacques Rousseau was an influential Genevan philosopher whose political philosophy influenced the progress of the Enlightenment. He wrote 'The Social Contract' in 1762.

subject: Social Studies
text: What is the standard meridian of India?
explanation: The standard meridian of India is 82°30'E.

subject: Social Studies
text: Which right was removed from the list of Fundamental Rights by the 44th Amendment?
explanation: The Right to Property was removed from the list of Fundamental Rights and made a legal right.

subject: Social Studies
text: In the context of the Russian Revolution, who were the Bolsheviks?
explanation: The Bolsheviks were a faction of the Marxist Russian Social Democratic Labour Party which split apart from the Menshevik faction and eventually formed the Communist Party of the Soviet Union.

options.text: A majority socialist group led by Lenin

subject: Social Studies
explanation: The poverty line is an imaginary line used by any country to determine its poverty based on income or consumption levels.

options.text: A line dividing poor and rich states
An indicator based on income or consumption to measure poverty
A physical line where poor people live

subject: Social Studies
text: Which of the following is a fundamental right?
explanation: The Right to Constitutional Remedies allows citizens to move the Supreme Court to enforce other fundamental rights.

subject: Social Studies
text: Which ocean lies to the south of India?
explanation: The Indian Ocean lies to the south of the Indian subcontinent.
